subtitle: Brings back the block edge outlines from the original Minecraft Dungeons.
description:
Edge Outline

Brings back the block edge outlines from the original Minecraft Dungeons.

Every block, slab and stair gets a subtle outline along its edges, just like the first game. This includes houses and other buildings made from blocks, tree trunks, and the blocks in the inventory and menu. Characters, foliage and props are left alone.

Press END to toggle the outlines on and off. The key and the outline intensity can be changed in the Mods tab of the game's settings.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the EdgeOutline folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\EdgeOutline\EdgeOutline_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the EdgeOutline folder from ~mods.
